stared.definition: Looked at something for a long time.

medallion.definition: A large medal worn or kept as a special object.

bookmark.definition: Something put in a book to mark a page.

backpack.definition: A bag carried on the back.

treasure.definition: Valuable things such as gold or jewels.

pirates.definition: People who rob ships at sea.

parrot.definition: A colorful bird that can copy sounds.

rowboat.definition: A small boat moved with oars.

captain.definition: The person in charge of a ship.

island.definition: Land with water all around it.

shouted.definition: Spoke in a very loud voice.

ladder.definition: Steps used to climb up or down.

storm.definition: Weather with strong wind and heavy rain.

sharks.definition: Large sea fish with sharp teeth.

glittered.definition: Shone with many small flashes of light.
